"""Source code is embedded in each exported flow, including its imports."""

import base64
import hashlib
import json
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from lfx.custom import Component
from lfx.io import MultilineInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data, DataFrame


class ScienceFixtureBundle(Component):
    display_name = "合成样例数据包"
    description = "读取流程内嵌的人工表格、文本和文件，核对 SHA-256 后写入本次运行的临时目录。"
    name = "ScienceFixtureBundle"
    icon = "FlaskConical"
    inputs = [MultilineInput(name="bundle_base64", display_name="内嵌合成样例（Base64 JSON）", value="e30=")]
    outputs = [
        Output(name="table", display_name="样例表格", method="build_table", group_outputs=True),
        Output(name="data", display_name="文件与证据", method="build_data", group_outputs=True),
    ]

    def build_table(self) -> DataFrame:
        return DataFrame(json.loads(base64.b64decode(self.bundle_base64, validate=True)).get("records", []))

    def build_data(self) -> Data:
        bundle = json.loads(base64.b64decode(self.bundle_base64, validate=True))
        root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="studyui-science-"))
        outputs = root / "results"
        outputs.mkdir()
        paths = {"output": str(outputs)}
        for name, blob in bundle.get("assets", {}).items():
            if Path(name).name != name or name in {"", ".", "..", "output", "results"}:
                raise ValueError("Asset names must be simple unique filenames")
            raw = base64.b64decode(blob["base64"], validate=True)
            if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != blob["sha256"]:
                raise ValueError(f"Embedded asset checksum mismatch: {name}")
            path = root / name
            path.write_bytes(raw)
            paths[name] = str(path)
        return Data(data={**bundle.get("data", {}), "asset_paths": paths, "synthetic": True})

"""Native form for per-cell battery cycling summaries."""

from copy import deepcopy

import pandas as pd
from lfx.custom import Component
from lfx.io import BoolInput, DataFrameInput, DropdownInput, FloatInput, IntInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data, DataFrame, Message

from materials_quality.batch.native import native_frame, prepare_form
from materials_quality.common import json_value
from materials_quality.context import table_fingerprint
from materials_quality.science.battery import analyze_battery_cycles
from materials_quality.science.table_contract import contract_identity, read_contract

COLUMNS = {
    "cell_id": "cell",
    "cycle": "cycle",
    "discharge_capacity": "discharge_capacity",
    "charge_capacity": "charge_capacity",
    "time": "time",
    "current": "current",
    "phase": "phase",
}


class BatteryCycles(Component):
    display_name = "材料批量·电池循环与容量保持率"
    description = "从逐循环容量表或相位电流曲线得到逐电芯放电容量、保持率与可选库仑效率，保留异常循环。"
    name = "BatteryCycles"
    icon = "BatteryCharging"
    inputs = [
        DataFrameInput(name="input_table", display_name="电池循环数据表", required=True),
        DropdownInput(
            name="mode",
            display_name="输入数据类型",
            options=["summary", "raw"],
            value="summary",
            real_time_refresh=True,
            info="summary 为逐循环容量表，raw 为带相位的时间与电流采样。",
        ),
        *[
            DropdownInput(
                name=f"{COLUMNS[column]}_column",
                display_name=label,
                options=[column],
                value="" if column == "charge_capacity" else column,
                combobox=True,
            )
            for column, label in (
                ("cell_id", "电芯标识列"),
                ("cycle", "循环序号列（正整数）"),
                ("discharge_capacity", "放电容量列"),
                ("charge_capacity", "充电容量列"),
                ("time", "相位时间列"),
                ("current", "电流列"),
                ("phase", "相位列（charge / discharge / rest）"),
            )
        ],
        DropdownInput(name="capacity_unit", display_name="输入容量单位", options=["Ah", "mAh"], value=""),
        DropdownInput(
            name="time_unit", display_name="输入时间单位", options=["ms", "s", "min", "h"], value=""
        ),
        DropdownInput(name="current_unit", display_name="输入电流单位", options=["A", "mA"], value=""),
        DropdownInput(
            name="current_sign",
            display_name="电流符号约定",
            options=["discharge_negative", "discharge_positive"],
            value="",
        ),
        FloatInput(
            name="sign_tolerance_a",
            display_name="反号电流容差（A）",
            value=0,
            info="默认严格检查电流符号。容差内的实测电流仍按净值积分。",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        IntInput(name="baseline_cycle", display_name="基准循环（0 为每个电芯首个有效循环）", value=0),
        BoolInput(
            name="calculate_efficiency",
            display_name="已确认同一循环的充放电可比，计算库仑效率",
            value=False,
            real_time_refresh=True,
            info="需确认充放电窗口和协议可比。原始数据还要求同一循环内全部充电相位先于放电。",
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(name=name, display_name=label, method=f"build_{name}", group_outputs=True, cache=False)
        for name, label in (
            ("features", "逐电芯循环结果"),
            ("report", "结果与追溯"),
            ("summary", "运行摘要"),
        )
    ]

    def _config(self):
        config = {
            "mode": self.mode,
            "cell_id": self.cell_column,
            "cycle": self.cycle_column,
            "baseline_cycle": self.baseline_cycle,
            "calculate_efficiency": self.calculate_efficiency,
        }
        if self.mode == "summary":
            config.update(discharge_capacity=self.discharge_capacity_column, capacity_unit=self.capacity_unit)
            if self.calculate_efficiency:
                config["charge_capacity"] = self.charge_capacity_column
        else:
            config.update(
                time=self.time_column,
                current=self.current_column,
                phase=self.phase_column,
                time_unit=self.time_unit,
                current_unit=self.current_unit,
                current_sign=self.current_sign,
                sign_tolerance_a=self.sign_tolerance_a,
            )
        return config

    def _result(self):
        fingerprint = table_fingerprint(self.input_table)
        contract = contract_identity(self.input_table)
        config = self._config()
        key = (fingerprint, contract, config)
        cached = self._ctx.get("battery_cycles")
        if cached is None or cached[0] != key:
            cached = (key, analyze_battery_cycles(self.input_table, config))
            self._ctx["battery_cycles"] = cached
        return cached

    def build_features(self) -> DataFrame:
        return native_frame(self._result()[1].features)

    def build_report(self) -> Data:
        (fingerprint, contract, config), result = self._result()
        return Data(
            data={
                "schema_version": "science-result/1",
                "operation": "materials.battery_cycles",
                "data": deepcopy(result.data),
                "warnings": list(result.warnings),
                "artifacts": [],
                "features_contract": read_contract(result.features),
                "features_fingerprint": table_fingerprint(result.features),
                "features_preview": json_value(
                    {
                        "total_rows": len(result.features),
                        "records": result.features.head(20).to_dict("records"),
                        "units": result.features.attrs["units"],
                    }
                ),
                "provenance": {
                    "input_sha256": fingerprint,
                    "input_contract_sha256": contract,
                    "parameters": config,
                    "raw_preserved": True,
                },
            }
        )

    def build_summary(self) -> Message:
        counts = self._result()[1].data["counts"]
        return Message(
            text=f"共 {counts['total']} 个电芯循环，有效 {counts['valid']}，"
            f"部分有效 {counts['partial']}，无效 {counts['invalid']}。"
        )

    def to_frontend_node(self, *args, **kwargs):
        result = super().to_frontend_node(*args, **kwargs)
        self.update_build_config(result["data"]["node"]["template"], None)
        return prepare_form(result)

    def update_build_config(self, build_config, field_value, field_name=None):
        if field_name in {"mode", "calculate_efficiency"}:
            build_config[field_name]["value"] = field_value
        raw = build_config["mode"].get("value", self.mode) == "raw"
        efficiency = build_config["calculate_efficiency"].get("value", self.calculate_efficiency)
        for field in (
            "time_column",
            "current_column",
            "phase_column",
            "time_unit",
            "current_unit",
            "current_sign",
            "sign_tolerance_a",
        ):
            build_config[field]["show"] = raw
        for field in ("discharge_capacity_column", "capacity_unit"):
            build_config[field]["show"] = not raw
        build_config["charge_capacity_column"]["show"] = not raw and bool(efficiency)
        if field_name == "input_table" and isinstance(field_value, pd.DataFrame):
            for prefix in COLUMNS.values():
                build_config[f"{prefix}_column"]["options"] = field_value.columns.tolist()
        return build_config

cfg_dpi.info: 留空随预设（预览 150、论文 300）；手填整数 72–1200。TIFF 使用 600 dpi，栅格不得超过 5000 万像素。

cfg_dpi_enabled.name: cfg_dpi_enabled
cfg_dpi_enabled.info: 关闭时使用方法的自动/默认设置；开启后填写数值。

cfg_evidence_role.name: cfg_evidence_role
cfg_evidence_role.info: 例如 comparison、diagnostic；留空由图型设定。该标签不构成科学验证。

cfg_formats.name: cfg_formats
cfg_formats.info: 留空沿用预设；可填写 png、svg、pdf、tiff。始终保留 PNG 预览；SVG 文字可编辑。

cfg_group.name: cfg_group
cfg_group.info: 可选，填写实际分组列名；不能缺失。留空把全部观测视为一组。小提琴图每组至少两个不同数值。

cfg_height_mm.name: cfg_height_mm
cfg_height_mm.info: 可选，须同时指定宽度或使用 paper 预设才生效；范围 50.8–762 mm。最终尺寸还受栅格像素上限约束。

cfg_height_mm_enabled.name: cfg_height_mm_enabled

cfg_labels.name: cfg_labels
cfg_labels.info: 键填原始列名，值填轴标签；列选择仍使用原始列名。

cfg_method.name: cfg_method
cfg_method.info: scatter 散点；bar 均值±样本标准差；box 四分位箱图；violin 核密度。各图保留全部观测点。

cfg_output_dir.name: cfg_output_dir
cfg_output_dir.info: 留空创建临时目录；同名文件自动使用新名称，输出清单保留原始数值。

cfg_profile.name: cfg_profile
cfg_profile.info: preview 默认 150 dpi PNG；paper 默认 300 dpi PNG/SVG/PDF/TIFF，并生成图件清单与图注；TIFF 固定 600 dpi。

cfg_purpose.name: cfg_purpose
cfg_purpose.info: 用于图件证据清单；留空使用标题或图型名称。

cfg_title.name: cfg_title
cfg_title.info: 留空使用各图型的默认标题；应准确描述比较对象或诊断问题。

cfg_units.name: cfg_units
cfg_units.info: 键填原始列名，值填单位（如 stress → MPa）；用于标注并与输入单位元数据核对，不改变数值。

cfg_width_mm.name: cfg_width_mm
cfg_width_mm.info: 留空沿用预设（预览 177.8、论文 150 mm）；手填 50.8–762 mm。指定宽度后默认高度为宽度的 0.66。

cfg_width_mm_enabled.name: cfg_width_mm_enabled
cfg_width_mm_enabled.info: 关闭时使用方法的自动/默认设置；开启后填写数值。

cfg_x.name: cfg_x
cfg_x.info: 填写实际数值列名；散点图要求横、纵轴均为有限数值。

cfg_y.name: cfg_y
cfg_y.info: 填写实际列名；要求有限数值。误差棒表示样本离散程度，不代表显著性。
